verdict.rationale: Crossplane's CLI supports 'testing and rendering standalone Composition Functions without the need to access a Kubernetes cluster' (crossplane-docs-7), which offers a limited local preview of composition output, but there is no documented feature that shows a full diff of creates/updates/destroys against live cluster state akin to a plan/apply workflow — Crossplane's model is continuous reconciliation (crossplane-docs-18) rather than plan-then-apply. missing for 10: explicit plan/diff output showing creates, updates, and destroys against live state; independent hands-on confirmation of this preview workflow.
